content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form that comes with the notice and fill it in. Attach self-attested copies of certificates of age, educational qualification, experience, caste, non-creamy layer and any additional qualification, and bring the originals. Report at the Administration Block, AD A 5 Section of the University at 10:00 AM on 10 December 2026. Attend the walk-in interview at 11:00 AM in the Vice Chancellor's chamber on 10 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the AD A 5 Section at 10:00 AM on 10 December 2026 with the application form and certificates.
